And as a new dad, I get 30-60 minutes in a day to game and I love the flexibility of playing on the console or hopping in remotely with my handheld. While I've been a PC gamer for over 30 years, I don't have time to fiddle with settings to get the best performance for my gear and the simplified experience on Xbox has made jumping into a game a lot faster. Not to mention Quick Resume.
